candidates.name: Zuluf-Ju'aymah Crude Oil Pipeline
aka: Zuluf AH Crude Oil Increment Project pipeline
candidates.from: Zuluf field onshore gas-oil separation plant (GOSP-4) / Tanajib processing complex

evidence.note: Describes new downstream pipelines built as part of the Zuluf oil field expansion carrying stabilized crude oil from the new GOSP to the Ju'aymah crude oil terminal, separate from the gas/condensate line to Tanajib gas plant.

Confirms route Zuluf field -> Ju'aymah Terminal for stabilized crude oil via new downstream pipeline, operator Saudi Aramco, expected completion 2020 (project since expanded further under later Zuluf increment phases through 2026-2027).

candidates.why_maybe_new: No roster row names Zuluf, Tanajib, or Ju'aymah as endpoints of a Zuluf-origin line. The closest geographically/thematically similar rows are P1958 (Safaniyah-Juaymah Oil Pipeline) and P5135 (Marjan Oil Pipeline, a distinct field's new line to the Eastern Province, already captured) - both are different offshore fields with their own dedicated crude pipelines built under separate Aramco increment programs. This is Zuluf's own new crude trunkline to Ju'aymah built under the Zuluf AH Crude Oil Increment / Zuluf field expansion program (contracts from ~2017-2019 onward, still referenced as advancing toward a 2026-2027 full-capacity target in 2026 reporting), and it has no matching PID in the roster. Secondary source (Denys Arabia project page, not independently fetchable this pass) names the specific line 'ZFJ-1', 42-inch diameter, Arabian Heavy crude, Zuluf field to Ju'aymah Terminal (JT) - flagged for the consolidator to corroborate diameter/length via Aramco or contractor documentation before finalizing a row.
